caption:
Your 4.8 rating from last year is starting to work against you.

BrightLocal's 2026 Local Consumer Review Survey found 74% of consumers only trust reviews from the last three months, and 32% want reviews from the last two weeks, up from 20% a year ago.

Most shops treat reviews like a one-time project: a push after a slow month, then silence for six. By month three, every one of those reviews has aged out of the window that moves a buying decision.

Fix it at the source. Text the review request within 24 hours of every completed job, while the work is still fresh.

See it running on your own jobs.
